mods.name: Eslium
mods.description: Predicts server actions to reduce latency effects

releases.notes:
Cross-version ghosting and performance update.

- Fixed ghost throwables on 1.16.5 clients connecting to 1.21.11 servers: predicted spawns are matched by entity type and proximity instead of exact protocol fields, and predicted spawn packets are never replayed as duplicates.
- Fixed a first-anchor crash: the precomputed glowstone blast-offset table was sized for 81 offsets but the sphere needs 93.
- Anchors skip idle simulation and repeat raycasts, reuse inventory stack references, throttle cleanup, and use precomputed blast offsets. Walksy's entity-in-block guard is included.
- Block placement absorbs the prediction when the authoritative block packet arrives, so ghost blocks disappear immediately.
- Credits: Walksy (entity guard), Oushii (precomputed blast offsets), cutebow and Herobane (reference ideas) - see the README for details.

Includes the earlier disconnect/dimension NPE fixes and lower per-frame overhead from 4.0.6 / 4.6.1.

Source: https://github.com/1szco1/Eslium-Backport

mods.name: Eslium
mods.description: Predicts server actions to reduce latency effects

releases.notes:
Stability and performance release for Minecraft 1.21.11.

- Fixed intermittent null-pointer crashes on disconnect and dimension changes: prediction hooks now require the network handler's world/level to be the same object as the client world before running.
- Pending packets, fake entities and inventory snapshots are cleared immediately when leaving a server or when the mod is inactive.
- Added null guards to the packet-apply, rollback, interaction and item-prediction paths.
- Reduced per-frame overhead: entity show/hide skips work when nothing is pending and uses a HashSet for ID lookups, inventory restores are bounds-checked, and empty packet maps are skipped.
- Entity removal now frees its static slot even when no world is available.
- README updated with a stability and performance section.

Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/project/5gn0R1Gq/version/4.6.1
Source: https://github.com/1szco1/Eslium-Backport

mods.description: Predicts server actions to reduce latency effects

releases.notes:
Initial 1.21.11 port of Eslium.

Fixes:
- Fixed a startup crash where the config directory was null during client init (config is now resolved lazily through FabricLoader)
- Fixed the potion mixin targeting a method that no longer exists in 1.21.11
- Fixed a crash when opening the config screen caused by a duplicate background blur within a single frame
- Fixed a startup crash on older Fabric Loader builds (MixinExtras 0.5.0) triggered by a `@Redirect` on ClientPacketListener; the latency ping is now driven without it

Included:
- Full feature port from the 1.16.5 build
- Anchors, placement, throwables, tools, weapons, combat and consumables
- Elytras, firework, windcharge, interactables, redstone and cooldowns
- Pose, optout, swap, crystals and minecarts predictions
- Config parity with 19 sections plus simulatedDesync
- In-game configuration through Mod Menu (optional) or the rebindable config keybind
- A main config menu listing every prediction, with an on/off toggle on each row and a sub-menu opened by clicking the row for its individual settings
- README configuration documentation
